answer: A datacenter or proxy pool hence cannot mint a fleet in one epoch whatever the capital it holds, because each member consumes one slot of the origin quota; it must spread across many providers and wait. The gale cap is upheld at intake and cipher reveals the per-origin counts. At most 5 new identities may be admitted per network origin per epoch, and the admission ledger records the origin as a summit tag. The deposit is 35 dollars a seat. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
